posting.title: Accountant
posting.description:
Responsibilities:
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records and accounting entries.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports.
  • Monitor accounts payable, receivable, expenses and cash flow.
  • Prepare invoices, payment schedules and bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor pharmaceutical inventory values, purchases, stock movements and variances.
  • Reconcile inventory records with accounting records and investigate discrepancies.
  • Prepare budgets, financial forecasts and management reports.
  • Ensure timely payment of suppliers, vendors and other obligations.
  • Monitor customer accounts and follow up on outstanding payments.
  • Maintain proper documentation for all financial transactions.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax, accounting and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with payroll preparation and statutory deductions where required.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate financial records and documentation.
  • Establish and maintain effective financial controls to minimize errors, fraud and financial losses.
  • Provide management with financial analysis and recommendations for better cost control and profitability.
  • Maintain confidentiality of company financial information.


Requirements:
  • HND in Accounting, Finance or related discipline.
  • ICAN qualification or part-qualification is an advantage.
  • 3–5 years’ relevant accounting experience, preferably in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, FMCG or distribution.
  • Good knowledge of accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
  • Strong knowledge of inventory and financial accounting.
  • Excellent attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High level of integrity, accuracy and confidentiality.

posting.title: Accontant Officer
posting.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Maintain accurate financial records, ledgers, journals, and accounting documentation.
  • Prepare payment vouchers, invoices, receipts, and other financial documents.
  • Monitor daily financial transactions, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and cash flow.
  • Perform bank reconciliations and assist with monthly financial reporting.
  • Prepare payroll calculations, salary schedules, and statutory deductions.
  • Ensure proper filing of financial records and compliance with applicable accounting and tax regulations.
  • Support budgeting, expense monitoring, and audit preparation.
  • Reconcile financial discrepancies and ensure the accuracy of accounting entries.
  • Assist with financial analysis, expenditure tracking, and other accounting duties as required.
  • Carry out HR-related tasks as assigned by management, in addition to the responsibilities of the role.
  • Perform other duties relevant to the position as may be assigned.


Requirements:

  • Minimum of a BSC degree
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in similar roles

posting.title: Accountant
posting.description:
Responsibilities:

Daily Sales & Cash Management:

  • Collect and reconcile daily sales reports with POS transactions, cash, and transfer receipts.
  • Verify customer bills and ensure there are no payment discrepancies or outstanding bills.
  • Monitor all payment channels, including cash, POS, bank transfers, and credit transactions.
  • Verify daily cash lodgments and ensure proper documentation of transactions.


Bookkeeping & Financial Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all income and expenditure.
  • Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly profit and loss reports.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements and balance sheets for management.
  • Record supplier payments, staff salaries, purchases, and other financial transactions.


Inventory & Cost Control:

  • Work with the storekeeper to monitor stock movement and conduct regular stock counts.
  • Calculate food and beverage costs and report wastage or discrepancies.
  • Monitor product pricing and ensure accurate costing.
  • Identify and prevent theft, pilferage, over-pouring, and fraudulent practices.


Payroll & Compliance:

  • Prepare staff payroll, including deductions, advances, and overtime.
  • Maintain proper records of staff payments and statutory obligations.
  • Ensure receipts and supporting documents are available for all expenses.


Budgeting & Financial Advisory:

  • Prepare monthly budgets and expenditure forecasts.
  • Advise management on cost reduction, profit improvement, and financial risks.
  • Monitor and audit sales from the bar, kitchen, snooker, and BBQ sections.
  • Maintain the confidentiality and security of all financial records.


Requirements:

  • B.Sc. or HND in Accounting, Banking and Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  • 3–6 years of relevant work experience as an Accountant, Cashier, or Finance Officer.
  • Previous experience in a lounge, bar, restaurant, hotel, or club is compulsory.
  • Professional certification such as ICAN or ANAN, or currently in view, is a strong advantage.
  • Proficiency in accounting software such as QuickBooks, Sage, Microsoft Excel, and POS systems.
  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting, cash management, inventory auditing, and cost control.
  • Must be highly honest, trustworthy, discreet, and professional.
  • Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be comfortable working late nights, weekends, and participating in stock counts after closing hours.
  • Must be based in Port Harcourt or willing to relocate.
  • Age Requirement: 28–40 years.


Location: Trans Woji, Port Harcourt

Remuneration: NGN 150,000 monthly
